title: Judah al-Ḥarizi, Taḥkemoni: reading edition with English translation
description:
The Hebrew maqamat that were the model for Immanuel's Maḥberot, with an English translation line by line. Pilot: the debate of the pen and the sword.

Line-aligned Hebrew and English, one English line for each rhyme unit or verse line.

Read online: https://openseforim.org/tahkemoni/
